independent_ast_checks.sole_predicate_change: Full decoded gzip SHA256 is streamed to EOF instead of retaining the full decoded byte string.

isolation_review: Each forked child runs exactly one original mutator and then the original audit against its copy-on-write address space.
Only AssertionError, KeyError, IndexError, ValueError or TypeError raised by audit count as rejection. Mutator errors are outside that handler.
Accepted mutants, unexpected exceptions, signals, nonzero exits, malformed/missing receipts and oversized diagnostics fail the parent.
Controls execute serially in their original order. The parent template and separately parsed baseline objects remain unchanged.
Without fork the original pickle-copy isolation is retained. The optional resource import does not affect scientific outputs.
lifetime_review: The parent is a separately parsed ancestral bank template. Only its first224 data owners are compared; all remaining call metadata comparisons exclude owners. Its helper-owner tail is not inspected or passed to another reader.
The actual hosted ct retains every one of the1321920 helper roles, the complete pooled-slot rows, all physical routes and all rank/chronology/nonaliasing checks.
The touches map has only its initialization and append uses; no returned or audited result reads it.
Streaming SHA256 hashes the same decoded bytes to EOF. Raw compressed hashes of source artifacts are unchanged.
limits: This is a source, isolation and bounded-fixture review; it does not claim completion of the massive whole-owner replay.
The old exit-minus9 report alone is not evidence of a specific cause; failure to finish never counts as successful rejection.
The max_rss_kib diagnostic is in KiB on Linux and uses different operating-system units on macOS; no scientific receipt depends on it.

unchanged_emitter.mechanism: Exact source pin and pass-through with the predecessor pickle-copy acceleration.
